entries.prompt:

Preserve the existing gold-white center, ellipse orientation, viewpoint, overall direction and proportions. The objective is to add fire edges and a few embers, not replace the recognisable original effect. Do not paint a black/checkerboard background, vignette, frame, floor or reflection. No text.
